decisions: Retain existing source pins. The new main range selects another Metal runtime and adds graphics inspection/telemetry, fork inventory and macOS tools. The full 144-file range and selected Metal history were not fully audited or rebased to iPhone Darwin 22.

Selected build differences propagate the OS profile/toolchain inputs and preserve unchanged cached XNU source timestamps with rollback on preparation failure. The local selected native route already compiles recorded Darwin 22/iOS16 recipes, stages exact overlays separately and preserves the cached baseline. No generic build-driver upgrade is imported by this change.

Pagani peripheral, GopFramebuffer and QcomGeniSpi observed tips remain unchanged. The HID fix is derived from this board source and original pinned iPhone lifetime bodies, not a foreign OS binary binding.
scope: Four selected remote references and targeted build-source differences. Supplements prior reviews without claiming a fresh audit of all repositories or the entire new Metal runtime.
